newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia Airlines buys CFM engines for A319 fleet.
newsitem.headline: Croatia Airlines buys CFM engines for A319 fleet.

text.p: Croatian flag carrier Croatia Airlines said on Friday it bought 12 CFM 56-type engines worth $60 million from a French-American supplier CFM International.
The engines are for the state-owned airline's six new A319 planes, ordered from Airbus last month.
"But this purchase may be extended with engines for other (Airbus) aircraft that are under option," marketing vice president Kresimir Magdic told a news conference.
Some 50 percent of the purchase price will be offset by exports of Croatian goods, Magdic said. He named turbine maker Tvornica Plinskih Turbina as one of the potential suppliers.
The agreement was signed in Zagreb today.
